status: Unshipped prototype: pure/retracting results improve, but all measured mixed COUNT contexts lose to stock. Additional optimization is required before enabling this feature.
feature: Typed DISTINCT first/last with multiplicity-only cached-result reuse
method: Identical queries/data/resources per comparison, runtime row source, both transposes, production JNI/IPC/state and rowwise blackhole sink. Native plan and consumed input metrics asserted. Interleaved engine order, all warmups and repeated trials retained. No concurrent local build/test/profile/timing. recordCount mixed mode extends COUNT(DISTINCT v) with COUNT(*), while existing SINGLE mixed mode is unchanged.

mixed_fixture.new_options: mixed adds COUNT(DISTINCT v), recordCount adds COUNT(*); SINGLE mixed SQL stays unchanged

validation.floating_sql: Both pure ordered functions and mixed COUNT queries, including signed zeros/NaN payloads; two backend restores; typed recovery uses pure filtered/unfiltered ordered functions
